Manifesto.label: Who we are
Manifesto.text: We are an engineering team in Tijuana. We connect your machines to your systems so <line>data</line> reaches the people who decide in <clock>real time</clock>. No spreadsheets that contradict each other, no reports that arrive late: your <bars>processes</bars>, visible and measured.
